clauses.text:
By virtue of the authority vested in me 
by the Constitution and the statutes, it 
is ordered that Executive Order No. 9240, 
as amended, entitled “Regulations Re­
lating to Overtime Wage Compensation”, 
is hereby revoked, effective as of the date 
of this order.
